heading: INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM, ELEVENTH FLOOR - MORNING

units.text: INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM, ELEVENTH FLOOR - MORNING
Pale light through venetian blinds.
A box of tissues, deliberately placed.
DR. ANAND PILLAI (50s, soft-spoken, cardigan under his coat) turns a folder over in his hands.
NURSE BRIDGET MOONEY (40s, quiet) stands by the door.
CASIMIR WOJTYLA (70s, retired tailor, pressed shirt) sits very straight, hands folded over his cap.
My scans look good, yes? You called me in early only to tell me to stop worrying.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Mr. Wojtyla, thank you for coming in.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: Can I get you some water?
units.name: BRIDGET

units.text: Water, no. I would like the news. The weather I can see for myself.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: The scans were clear in the lungs.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: There. You see, Bridget? I told you the cough was the cold weather.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: You did.
units.name: BRIDGET

units.text: Mr. Wojtyla, the scan did find something else.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: What something?
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: A shadow on the liver. Two, in fact.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: Shadows. I have spent forty years looking at shadows on cloth. They come out with a good steam.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Mr. Wojtyla--
units.name: BRIDGET

units.text: ^These will not come out with steam, I am afraid.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: So. It is that kind of shadow.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Yes.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: And how long does that kind of shadow give a man?
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Months. Perhaps more, with treatment.
units.name: PILLAI

units.text: Months. (beat) Thank you for saying it plainly. Bridget, you may stop holding the door. I am not going to run.
units.name: CASIMIR
